name: Çam Ağacı
scene: a simple pine tree on a hill
notes: Small opening-level design: 16 visually counted closed panes (5 tree panes and 11 background panes), within target 12–22. Tree greens alternate; sky and hill use only alternating amber and blue. Inspected after one regeneration: no obvious open lines or X junctions. Broad curved tiers preserve the pine silhouette. Remaining doubts: subtle generated shading/texture persists despite the flat-fill revision; hill-band left endpoint tapers and should be checked during tracing. Opaque white exterior composited for final PNG. Design sheet only; not traced or published.

generation.promptSummary: Simple centered pine on a hill in an oval, 12–22 closed panes, green subject pair, amber/blue background pair, uniform black lead, T junctions only; revision requested flat fills and corrected lower hill alternation.
